# `ExpectBuilder`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\ExpectBuilder`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/ExpectBuilder.php#L19) — **Version:** v0.9.0-2-g2ad61e3

**Extends:** [`WhenBuilder`](/api/classes/WhenBuilder)

**Type parameters:**

- `TReturn of mixed = mixed`

Configures a call the code under test is expected to make. Everything a
stub can say applies here too; the difference is that an expectation is a
claim about what happens, checked by `verifyAll()`, and defaults to exactly
one call.

## Methods

### ordered()

```php
ordered(): static
```

Requires this call to happen in the order it was declared, relative to
the other ordered expectations. Other calls may happen in between.
